title: 12 Best Vegan Restaurants in Berlin
description: Discover the 12 best vegan restaurants in Berlin for 2026, from upscale zero-waste dining to classic vegan döner. Find top picks for every budget and experience.

places.name: Frea
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The daily changing 5-course tasting menu is the only option, ensuring you experience their freshest, most innovative creations.

places.name: Kopps
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal takes on classic German dishes like Königsberger Klopse or innovative risotto variations are always a hit.

places.name: Viasko
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Schnitzel' with potato salad or their legendary vegan Goulash are must-tries for a taste of German comfort.

places.name: Vöner
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The classic 'Vöner Teller' (döner plate) or a 'Vöner im Brot' (döner in bread) with all the fixings.

places.name: Brammibal's Donuts
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a classic like the salted caramel or a seasonal special like Pistachio Lemon. Don't forget their excellent coffee.

places.name: Alaska Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Patatas Bravas, 'Chorizo' al Vino, and a selection of their seasonal vegetable tapas are highly recommended.

places.name: Lia's Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Lia's Burger' with their signature sauces and a side of sweet potato fries.

places.name: Sfizy Veg
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try the 'Pizza Diavola' for a spicy kick or the 'Pizza Funghi' for a classic mushroom option. They also have great calzones.

places.name: Chaostheorie
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their vegan 'Currywurst' with fries is a fantastic local staple, or try one of their hearty burgers.

places.name: Mom's Creation
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Pho Chay' (vegan pho) is wonderfully comforting, or try the 'Bun Cha Gio' (vermicelli salad with spring rolls).

places.name: Rawtastic
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Zucchini Pasta' or the 'Raw Lasagna' are popular choices, and definitely save room for their delicious raw cheesecakes.

places.name: Vincent Vegan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Big V Burger' and a side of crispy fries with their special sauce are a classic combo.
